issues.description: The solution implementation declares Course.addRating(stars:) with a more restrictive visibility (private) than the template and the problem statement imply. The template's extension provides a non-private stub and the problem/client code expects addRating to be callable from Client (outside the Course file). Making the method private in the solution prevents external code from calling it and will confuse students about the required accessibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make addRating(stars:) non-private (remove the 'private' qualifier or use internal/public) in Course.swift so it matches the template and can be called from Client. Alternatively, if the intent is to keep it private, update the problem statement and template to document the intended access pattern and provide a public API for adding ratings.
